messages.author: Kankana Bhattacharjee
messages.body:
Dear AMBER users,
I am utilsing one of the tools of cpptraj, there I have to mention residue
names with their respective Ids as a solute mask. I have tried with:
":ASP54, MET64, ASN67", I think it is not correct. As I am not getting any
output.dat file. Please provide me suggestions.
Thanks & Regards
Kankana Bhattacharjee
Ph.D. Scholar
Department of Chemistry
Ashoka University
Sonipat, Haryana

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
This is because :ASP54 etc is not a valid mask. The ‘:’ operator should be
followed by a residue name or a number. In your case, just use the numbers,
e.g. :54.
Hope this helps,
-Dan
